subject: MATH251
filterSummary: Selected 10 videos (5 English, 5 Arabic) covering the 5 specified topics in Linear Algebra. The English selections include highly intuitive content from 3Blue1Brown and procedural walkthroughs from The Math Sorcerer and Dr. Trefor Bazett. The Arabic selections feature comprehensive lectures from popular educators like الأستاذ حماد السيلاوي, Mohamed Torky, and Anas Abu Zahra. All selections are highly relevant, meet quality gates, and directly address the specified student difficulties.

coverage.note: | dropped post-hoc: duration >3600s violates the hard gate
Several high-quality candidates were rejected for exceeding the 3600s duration limit.

videos.title: Example: Verifying Vector Space Axioms
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a complete, rigorous walkthrough of proving all 10 vector space axioms for a non-trivial example (complex numbers as a real vector space), which is perfect for students.

videos.title: How to Prove a Set is a Subspace of a Vector Space
videos.filter_reason: With a perfect title, massive view count, and concise format, this video is an excellent and highly-trusted resource for learning the procedure of proving a set is a subspace.

videos.title: Linear combinations, span, and basis vectors | Chapter 2, Essence of linear algebra
videos.filter_reason: This video is the gold standard for building intuition, directly addressing the student difficulty of visualizing span through exceptional animations and clear explanations.

videos.title: The Vector Space of Polynomials: Span, Linear Independence, and Basis
videos.filter_reason: This video perfectly addresses the topic by focusing on the vector space of polynomials, clearly explaining how concepts like span, linear independence, and basis apply to abstract objects.

videos.title: Coordinate Vectors Relative to a Basis | Linear Algebra
videos.filter_reason: This video clearly explains the definition of a coordinate vector relative to a basis and provides multiple worked examples, including for abstract spaces like polynomials, which is highly relevant.

videos.title: Subspace (الفضاء الجزئي) - شرح كامل بالتفصيل مع امثله وطرق مختلفه للحل
videos.filter_reason: This is a comprehensive and extremely popular video that provides a detailed explanation of subspace proofs with multiple examples, making it an ideal choice for students.

videos.title: محاضرة 15 (التركيب الخطي Linear Combination). نوار الأسدي
videos.filter_reason: This is a well-regarded lecture with high viewership that provides a solid, focused explanation of linear combinations, a foundational part of this topic.

videos.title: الارتباط الخطي والاستقلال الخطي (Linear dependence - Linear independence )
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video provides a comprehensive explanation of linear dependence and independence, including examples with matrices and polynomials which are key for abstract spaces.

videos.title: 4.4 Basis and Coordinates
videos.filter_reason: This is a very popular and clear lecture that covers both basis and coordinate vectors, directly explaining how to find coordinates relative to a basis, which is the core of the topic.
